home.intro: I work with data and artificial intelligence. Outside work I run, play and coach chess, and organise sports events.
home.aboutP1: I work in data and artificial intelligence. I studied at the Prague University of Economics and Business, where my master's thesis examined how Czech companies adopt AI in practice.
